posts.tagline: A timer that lives on the edge of every page
posts.description: Tuckit is a Pomodoro and focus timer that lives on the edge of every page. Drag the rope inward, let go, and the timer starts - 5 minutes to 4 hours, or a whole Pomodoro run in one gesture. It keeps running as you move between tabs, blocks the sites you name while you focus, and records what you actually did - including the gap between the time you asked for and the time you really spent. Free, no account, and nothing leaves your machine.

posts.name: Kidaiz Launch
posts.tagline: Personalized AI learning for every stage of life
posts.description: Kidaiz turns any topic into a personalized learning experience. From adaptive K-12 courses and creative learning activities to TutorBoard for music, languages, professional skills and more. Learn at your level, your pace, your way.

posts.name: Backchannel
posts.tagline: The internet's commentary track.
posts.description: Backchannel brings the internet's conversations into whatever you're reading. It blends Hacker News, Bluesky, Reddit, and more into a single discussion thread beside any page, then brings those sources together into a blended front page when you're ready to find something new.

posts.name: Speedstand
posts.tagline: The ultimate data hub for Formula 1 fans
posts.description: F1 is more than just the race. Speedstand is an independent F1 data hub for fans who love exploring the details behind the sport. Follow race weekends, explore driver and team stats, dive into telemetry and strategy, and discover more about every circuit — all in one clean, focused app.

posts.name: Aethvra
posts.tagline: Build. Connect. Scale.
posts.description: Aethvra is an all-in-one workspace for projects, tasks, docs, CRM, client portals, HR, goals, dashboards, chat, time tracking, automations, AI and your startup network.

posts.name: Olmi
posts.tagline: Plant care habits, reminders, and photo identification
posts.description: Olmi helps new houseplant owners remember watering, track each plant's care, and build a routine that lasts. Start without an account, earn progress for consistent care, and use Pro photo identification when you do not know your plant.

posts.name: GeoSurfaced
posts.tagline: AI search visibility built for marketing agencies
posts.description: GeoSurfaced is an AI search visibility platform built for marketing agencies. Track how ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini mention your clients’ brands, compare their visibility against competitors, uncover opportunities, and turn AI search insights into actionable client work. Manage multiple brands from one place and show clients how they appear across the AI platforms shaping search and discovery.

posts.name: Apex Rental Pro
posts.tagline: Build Your Tent Empire
posts.description: Specialty tent and event rental software for build kits, inventory, quotes, contracts, 3D layouts, print sheets, website building, and scheduling. Built for tent and party rental companies at a lower price than the competition.

posts.name: Klowk Me
posts.tagline: you don’t have to be a criminal to value your privacy
posts.description: Founder of Klowk Me — the first patent-pending system engineered to defeat facial recognition at every layer. Eyewear. App. Identity protection. They can see you. We're changing that.

posts.name: SL4ME
posts.tagline: Shorten links. Scan them. Track them. In seconds.
posts.description: sl4.me is a fast, free URL shortener. Every link passes a 5-stage safety check, including Google Safe Browsing and bot protection. No account required—anonymous users get a daily quota, while signed-in users unlock monthly quotas, custom aliases (e.g., sl4.me/launch), and link editing. Update destination links anytime without changing the short URL or losing accumulated clicks. Built with real-time abuse prevention, privacy controls, and transparent open analytics.

posts.name: Substructure
posts.tagline: Slack agents your whole team can use, from one config file
posts.description: Substructure runs AI agents in the cloud instead of on someone's laptop. Write a TOML file, run subs apply, and you have a Slack agent connected to MCP servers your team uses. Override any step of the agent loop with a webhook into your own system. Self-host it or let us run it.

posts.name: Plume
posts.tagline: AI writes your LinkedIn posts in 10 seconds
posts.description: Plume turns a one-line idea into a ready-to-publish LinkedIn post — hook, structure, hashtags — in under 10 seconds. Choose a tone, generate the post, and publish it straight to LinkedIn in one click, no copy-pasting. Free to start: 4 posts/month, no credit card required. Built for founders and professionals who know posting consistently matters but never have the 20 minutes it takes to write something good. Launching in beta — your feedback shapes what's next.

posts.name: CameraFort
posts.tagline: Photo gear management tool
posts.description: Born in a Guns N' Roses concert line in Amsterdam, CameraFort is the ultimate vault for pro gear management. 🎸📸 ✅ AI Invoice Scanning: Auto-extract specs from receipts. ✅ Web Dashboard: Bulk import gear via desktop. ✅ Smart Kits: Organize setups & export pro PDF reports. ✅ Pro Reminders: Auto-alerts for charging, cleaning & warranties. ✅ Full Sync: Real-time data between iOS, Android & Web. Secure your photography arsenal across all devices today. 🏰✨

posts.name: Cash Cage
posts.tagline: Settle your poker night in the fewest possible payments
posts.description: Cash Cage tracks every buy-in and cash-out at your home poker game, then works out who pays who. A MILP solver finds the fewest transfers that square the whole table, or you can name a banker and have everyone settle through one person. Save each regular with their Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, Apple Cash, or Zelle handle, pick the night's rounding, and share a summary where every payment already has a handle attached

posts.name: Retouch4me Stray Hairs
posts.tagline: Tidy up flyaways and smooth frizz for a natural look
posts.description: AI-powered plugin to remove stray hairs and flyaways from portraits. Works with Photoshop & Lightroom. Professional hair retouching in 1 click.

posts.name: Oncology Ventures Substack
posts.tagline: Where to invest in cancer care + comedy, monthly
posts.description: Cancer care is a $210B+ system full of broken workflows, misaligned incentives, and data still trapped in fax machines. Ben Freeberg, cancer survivor and founder of Oncology Ventures, writes a monthly newsletter that breaks down exactly where the opportunities are. Each post has a bit of comedy, which readers have described as "pretty funny for a cancer newsletter". Join the 17,000+ healthcare investors, founders, and clinicians who subscribe.

posts.name: bePublish
posts.tagline: Content engine for solo brands that sell
posts.description: Build your own platform, escape social media algorithms, and sell your digital products globally with the TanaFlows Ghost theme.

posts.name: DentlFlow
posts.tagline: Run your dental lab from case intake to delivery
posts.description: DentlFlow is an end-to-end dental lab management platform that connects dentists, lab admins, and technicians in one workflow. Dentists submit cases with tooth charts, files, and instructions; labs manage production stages, technician assignments, inventory, costing, invoicing, and delivery tracking. Built for modern dental labs that want fewer manual handoffs, clearer case visibility, and more control from intake to completion.

posts.name: WalkBlock Kids Safety
posts.tagline: Block distracting apps while kids are walking
posts.description: Block distracting Android apps while your child walks or moves. WalkBlock provides parent PIN protection, allowed apps and no GPS tracking.

posts.name: Forkit
posts.tagline: Turn ideas into real, shareable AI-built products
posts.description: Buildfork turns an idea into a real product with AI. Create websites, games, images, and music with built-in user login, databases, and shared spaces. Preview and publish instantly, share your complete creation process, sell what you make, or remix products created by others.
